subject: Re: Encord & GetReal - catch up
text:
Hello Winnie,

Happy new year! Thank you for following-up and being patient with us. 
We were internally discussing about the conversation we had a couple of months ago on how Encord could help GetReal in our endeavors. 

One of the things we discussed about was the data collection and QA aspect of Encord. When we think of our immediate needs, we would like to understand if you would be able to help us out in that direction. 

Below are some details on what kind of data we are looking for:

Phase 1 goal (“remote-first”)

Participants record natural, “video-call style” talking-head videos on their own laptops/desktops (mobile is acceptable for a small percentage, ideally clearly tagged).

No fixed script or gesture list is required for this phase; we’re aiming for natural, conversational content.

A key requirement is unaltered/uncompressed/unmodified video from recording → transfer → final delivery, with clear lineage and QA checks to validate integrity.

Scale & structure (flexible)

Targeting ~1,000 participants (open to adjustment based on feasibility/cost).

~20–30 minutes total video per participant, captured as multiple short clips (e.g., 30–60 second segments) across a session or over a couple of days.

Delivery can be batched over ~4–8 weeks (or faster via staged drops, if preferred).

Demographics

We’d like a US-census-like distribution overall, but participants can be sourced globally (e.g., India/Asia/Africa/other regions) as long as the distribution targets are met.

Skin tone distribution is the primary demographic requirement for this phase.

Minimum technical bar

Minimum resolution: 640p (happy to align on a higher target if recommended).

Real-world environments are fine; we do not need “studio-perfect” audio/speech.

We expect structured metadata (CSV/JSON), including device type and self-reported demographics.

Could you let us know:

Whether Encord can run collection with the above constraints (especially preservation of uncompressed/unmodified
